info.title: BaSyx ReBAC access management extensions
info.description: Experimental opt-in OpenFGA extensions. Enable with REBAC_ENABLED. ABAC syntax and history/event-feed enforcement remain unchanged. Identifiers use the encoding of the corresponding BaSyx resource endpoint. Generated inheritance is read-only.
